svg.title: UNLOCK architecture, deployed and local
svg.desc: Deployed: a React and Three.js site on Cloudflare Pages reads recorded runs from a read-only Modal API, and a separate judge gateway runs private offline jobs. Local: the same frontend talks to a FastAPI coordinator, whose bounded agent controller calls the Meta Model API or a labelled offline policy. Both reach one engine, built on CadQuery and OpenCASCADE, with isolated native workers.
